analysis.reasonEn: RSI has moved out of oversold territory (35.5) into the neutral zone (50.2), but the ADX at 25.1 indicates no clear trend yet. MACD histogram is improving (-1.2884 → -0.2496) but remains negative. A higher low is forming (5-day low > 20-day low), suggesting a potential recovery, but the low volume ratio (0.44) weakens the conviction of a trend reversal. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted.
